Inside the film

Six layers, each with a job. Scroll to see what each one does. 向下滚动，了解每一层的作用。

  1. Scratch resistant hard coat抗刮耐磨层Stops everyday scratches and extends the life of the film.
  2. UV protection layer紫外线阻隔层Blocks up to 99% UV to protect the cabin and interior.
  3. Heat rejection layer隔热层Metal or ceramic nano particles reflect infrared and lower the cabin temperature.
  4. Tint and dye layer染色层Sets how dark the film is and gives you privacy.
  5. Adhesive layer黏合层Clear pressure-sensitive adhesive that bonds firmly to the glass.
  6. Release liner离型膜Protects the adhesive before installation, then peels off.
